hero.text: Feline Fairies is a foster-based rescue. Temporary homes give cats a safe place to settle while they wait for adoption.

image.alt: A cat relaxing comfortably in a foster home

why.lead: There is no shelter building. There is a community of foster homes.
why.text: Fostering makes space for a cat’s next chapter: somewhere to rest, settle into a routine, and be cared for while they wait for a home.

items.title: A safe space
items.text: Offer a calm temporary place for a cat to settle.

items.title: Everyday care
items.text: Provide routine care, attention, and a comfortable home environment.

items.title: Communication
items.text: Stay in touch with the rescue and share useful updates.

items.title: Help them get ready
items.text: Give a cat time and stability while they move toward adoption.

fit.text: You do not have to have every answer before starting a conversation. These questions can help you think about how fostering might fit into your home.
items: Do I have a safe area where a cat can settle?
Can I provide consistent day-to-day care?
Can I communicate with the rescue when needed?
Am I comfortable helping a cat adjust at their own pace?

process.title: One step at a time.
process.text: Start with an application. The rescue can help you explore whether there is a suitable opportunity.

items.title: Apply
items.text: Tell us about your home and interest in fostering.

items.title: Connect
items.text: A volunteer can follow up and talk through current needs.

items.title: Find the right fit
items.text: If there is a suitable opportunity, the rescue can discuss next steps with you.

items.title: Welcome a foster
items.text: Give a cat a temporary place to feel safe while they wait for what comes next.

closing.text: If fostering sounds like something you would like to explore, start with the application and tell us a little about your home.
